brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Triangular 3-cell base (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) joined with 3 side connectors, capped, ~364x384 mm footprint, compact to carry.
handle:0,0,0;top on cover:0,0,0;full;top at center of build, anchored via inserts insert:0,0,0;full;top;180/300/60 - provides centered grip for lifting.

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) = 5 separate compartments; staged with heap-screws-div3 (prop:2), heap-standoffs-div3 (prop:4), heap-screws-div2 (prop:1), heap-nuts-div3 (prop:5) showing segregated small hardware.

finish.summary: Built triangular tool caddy (3 hex cells) with centered carry handle on top cover and two divided bins (3-compartment + 2-compartment) providing 5 compartments for screws, nuts and standoffs/bits, dressed with hardware props visible from above; caps and locks applied, meshClash clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
